## Checked against PRINCIPLES.md

- [ ] Does this change what the tool reads, writes or sends? If yes: README, SECURITY.md and a flag to turn a new write off.
- [ ] Which number the user sees will show this helped (Trend, `--until`)? A test proves it works, not that it helped.
- [ ] What happens on data the tool cannot read?
- [ ] How do we undo it?
- [ ] What does the user have to learn now?
- [ ] CHANGELOG entry written; tests added; no transcript text, personal data or real paths.
